authorization.john_statement: continue ML-CRA development with ST08_04 after closure of ST08_03 and formation of ml_cra_v54.zip

important_decisions.decision: one installed mlcra command with audit verify and doctor subcommands
important_decisions.basis: PyPA project scripts and console_scripts entry point specification plus John universal CLI decision
important_decisions.consequence: CLI and dashboard must not develop independent verdict logic

important_decisions.decision: local UTF-8 CSV plus versioned JSON Schema specification and no untrusted executable serialization
important_decisions.basis: JSON Schema 2020-12 and official Python pickle security warning
important_decisions.consequence: pickle joblib cloudpickle arbitrary import paths implicit URLs and default network are unsupported

important_decisions.decision: 0.1.0 supports a bounded binary classification vertical slice while 1.0.0 additionally requires tabular regression
important_decisions.basis: observed current binary-only scientific and metric evidence plus John release ladder and SemVer public API boundary
important_decisions.consequence: regression and multiclass are rejected fail closed in 0.1.0 rather than overclaimed

important_decisions.decision: negative or fragile scientific verdict exits zero when execution and evidence are valid
important_decisions.basis: separation of software verification from scientific conclusion in the Stage 8 contract
important_decisions.consequence: automation can distinguish a valid negative finding from a program or evidence failure

important_decisions.decision: public development 0.1.0 and 1.0.0 are three independent fail closed gates with John authorization
important_decisions.basis: ISO requirements engineering NIST AI RMF MANAGE PyPA packaging flow SemVer and NIST SSDF
important_decisions.consequence: building a wheel does not authorize publication and no gate inherits owner acceptance automatically

important_decisions.decision: external utility observations are recorded without inventing a universal numeric usability threshold
important_decisions.basis: ISO 9241-11 usability is context user and goal specific and does not prescribe one evaluation method
important_decisions.consequence: community benefit remains an empirical post-use question
